faq: Where is New Era Public School, Dwarka?
In Sector 25, Dwarka, New Delhi 110077, on a 5-acre green campus.

New Era is a CBSE school from Nursery to Class XII. For 2027-28, pre-registration is open for Nursery, Lower KG, Upper KG and Class I to IX.

Yes. A mid-day meal is part of the monthly fee up to Class V.

The DoE has added Lower KG and Upper KG before Class I. A child's age on 31 March 2027 decides the class, and the uniform age for Class I is moving to 6+.

A child who has passed the previous class at a recognised school, with a valid School Leaving Certificate and mark sheet, is exempt from the age criteria for the next class.
